description: Espoon aurinkoenergiakartta is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Espoon kaupungin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. Solar energy map of Espoo. The report analysed the amount of solar radiation falling on the roof surfaces of all buildings in Espoo. The analysis was carried out using a three-dimensional model based on laser scanning data together with the weather data of the Finnish Meteorological Institute for the reference year. Coverage: Espoon kaupungin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. The portal shows the English title as "Espoo solar energy map" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Espoon kaupungin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. Its keywords include energialähteet, rakennukset, aurinkoenergia, energia. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOTIFF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
